lcelection
MLC Election 2026 ki 8 siton ke natijon aur jari voton ki ginti ke bich purniya se nirdaliy sansad pappu yadav ka bara aur vivadit bayan samne aaya hai. pappu yadav ne ek taraph jahan prashant kishor ki parti 'jan suraj', kangres aur sattadhari jediyu-bijepi-aarjedi ko aare hathon lete hue emaelsi chunav ko "dhanapshuon, maphiya aur paison ka khel" karar diya, vahin mokama vidhayak anant sinh ko jediyu se 6 sal ke lie nishkasit kie jane par satta paksh ki "istemal karo aur phenko" ki rajniti par tikha hamla bola hai.
